name: 42-nykur
description: Nykur: a fine dapple-grey water horse with a wet dark green weedy mane and tail, its hooves turned backwards. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing in place: the horse tosses its head up, its wet weedy mane swinging out, then lowers its head as if beckoning. Feet planted, same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
